gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified against the real WASM)

gaps.missing: script-setup compiler macros in the TYPE-LITERAL generic form — defineProps<{ id: string }>() and defineEmits<{ (e: 'save'): void }>() — emit NO prop/event symbols. Only the runtime object/array form ({ size: Number } / ['change']) is extracted; the standard Vue 3.3+ generic form loses the entire public contract.
gaps.evidence: probe: defineProps<{ id: string }>() -> no Property symbol for id; defineEmits<{ (e: 'save'): void }>() -> no Event symbol for save (TS tree: type_arguments -> object_type -> property_signature / call_signature)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (vue/generic-props-emits) + mutant vue/drop-generic-macro-symbols CAUGHT (2026-08-27). The type-literal generic form defineProps<{ id: string }>() / defineEmits<{ (e: 'save'): void }>() now extracts Property/Event symbols via the type_arguments -> object_type walk (property_identifier for props, first string literal per call_signature for emits). The component's public contract is no longer lost in the standard Vue 3.3+ shape. Extension (same session, post-wave review): union literal emit types now extract EVERY member (V1b, fixture vue/generic-union-emits + mutant vue/drop-union-emit-names CAUGHT).

gaps.missing: template expressions emit NO references to the component's own members — {{ count }}, @click="onSave", :label="label", v-model="count", v-if="show" read script-side state but no Uses/references edge is emitted. The template<->script data-flow is entirely silent.
gaps.evidence: probe: {{ count }} -> only instantiates for MyButton; zero edges to count/label/onSave/show
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (vue/template-member-uses) + mutant vue/drop-template-member-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Template expressions ({{ count }}, :label, @click, v-model, v-if) now emit Uses edges (isTemplateExpression) from the component to its member symbols; identifiers are collected from interpolation raw_text and directive attribute_value, resolved only against known script members (no junk edges to intrinsics). Extension (same session, post-wave review): scope-aware — template-local bindings (v-for loop vars, slot props) shadow same-named members and are suppressed (V4, fixture vue/template-scope-shadow + mutant vue/reemit-shadowed-uses CAUGHT).

gaps.missing: duplicate contains edges — the JS/TS sub-analyzer already emits contains for script-side symbols (class -> method), and the vue analyzer's own contains pass re-emitted them, doubling every class member's containment edge in the analyzer output (the store dedupes at INSERT, but the analyzer result and any consumer of it saw 2x).
gaps.evidence: probe: <script>class Base { go() {} }</script> -> contains: Base -> go emitted TWICE (once from the sub-analyzer merge, once from the vue pass)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (vue/script-relations expectRelationshipCount == 1) + mutant vue/reduplicate-contains CAUGHT (2026-08-27). The vue contains pass now skips (owner, member) pairs the sub-analyzer already covered, so vue-owned members (props/emits/options) still get contains while script-side class members keep exactly one edge. Harness gained expectRelationshipCount (exact-edge pinning) so relationship duplication is a permanent gate class.

gaps.missing: scope-blind template uses — v-for loop variables (v-for="item in items") and slot props (#default="{ row }") are template-LOCAL bindings, but the V2 collector emitted Uses to them whenever a same-named script member existed. False edges: the template reads the local item/row, not the member. The TS T6 shadowed-local bug class, unguarded in the template surface.
gaps.evidence: probe: v-for="item in items" + const item = ref(...) -> uses: comp -> item emitted (FALSE); #default="{ row }" + const row = ref(...) -> uses: comp -> row emitted (FALSE)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (vue/template-scope-shadow forbid item/row uses) + mutant vue/reemit-shadowed-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). The template walk now carries a shadow scope: v-for loop vars and slot-prop destructures are registered per-subtree and suppressed from Uses collection; the v-for collection expression (items) and unshadowed members (index, rowClick) still emit.

decisions.question: style blocks (CSS) are skipped entirely — no extraction. Recommend: DECLARED LIMITATION (CSS is handled by the dedicated css analyzer; the SFC analyzer owns structure + script).
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED LIMITATION (2026-08-27): style blocks are skipped entirely; CSS extraction belongs to the dedicated css analyzer, the SFC analyzer owns structure + script. Section A records style_element as handled_verified (structure) with the extraction limitation declared here.

decisions.question: v-on modifier tokens (.prevent, .stop) and dynamic directive arguments ([expr]) are structure-only — recommend INTERNAL SILENT.
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): v-on modifier tokens (.prevent, .stop) and dynamic directive arguments ([expr]) are syntax structure only; the binding VALUE expressions are covered by V2 uses. Slot-prop destructuring (#default="{ row }") is a LOCAL binding — shadowed per V4, not a member use.

decisions.question: error-recovery end-tag nodes — recommend INTERNAL SILENT (error handling).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): erroneous_end_tag nodes are tree-sitter error-recovery artifacts; the analyzer already reports parse errors, no extraction needed.

decisions.question: typeParameters payload: the SFC component itself has no generics; script-side TS generics are handled by the TS sub-analyzer. Recommend: DECLARED N/A at the SFC level.
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED N/A (2026-08-27): the SFC component itself has no generics; script-side TS generics are handled by the TS sub-analyzer. typeParameters payload row omitted from the vue Matrix (family contract).

decisions.question: apiContract payload: Vue has no framework API-contract concept (like groovy/JS) — recommend DECLARED N/A.
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED N/A (2026-08-27): Vue has no framework API-contract concept (like groovy/JS); the apiContract payload row is omitted from the vue Matrix.

decisions.node_type: HTML builtin tag set drift (analyzer vs F5 oracle)
decisions.question: Can modern HTML (search) or camelCase SVG tags surface as component usages?
decisions.ruling: NO — analyzer HTML_BUILTIN_TAGS = 134 tags incl. 2023 <search> and SVG camelCase; the F5 oracle's ORACLE_HTML_TAGS carried only 126 and faked MISSING instantiates->search (Navbar.vue). Oracle extended to the identical list; the drift is now pinned by vue/modern-html-svg-builtin-tags (forbids 8 native tags) + mutant vue/reemit-filtered-kebab-tags.
